seatedToss.guidance: Tula pombanda yomeja, nomudjudjanitha okutoloka oshimbwa shi tilila mondjolo ini nene. Dhimba omanga pepapela, pamwe.
steps: Shiputa omondjolo nelisimo lomanga, noku shi tuluka pefo pomeja pakati penu.
Tula nawa, omunye kombinga ndjoka omunye kombinga. Tilila omwe omwe, nenge kala po ngele omwa hala.
Ngele oshimbwa tashi kwata mondjolo, omuntu ndjoka a tilila ta dhimba omutaneko mouzapo we, pamuvo gwomondjolo ngoo.
Pamwe tala omaludhiko ngele mwa hala. Hakuna omuntu okwa pumbwa okukonga.
Yandja po ngele omuntu oye ta hala.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Shiyaka oshimbwa she na ekumbo lya pwa nenge sokisi yakundjwa, kala po, hamu tilila kombinga yomeho, nokala ngeno omukulunhu hepepi. Omaupyakadi ta vulu okudhenga.
safety: Shiyaka oshimbwa she na ekumbo lya pwa, nenge sokisi yakundjwa. Tala nawa kuuhalu nomatanga, opo kahe na oshinya shi kamone.
Omanga, mali nomaupyakadi dimwe odi nokudhenga. Dikaleni kaashona eyi, nakaantu ya tameke mo oshinya momanwa.
Kala pedu nolyokokaana, nokuhalitha ngele oshinya shi vulu okuyungiwa momanwa.
Kala po. Tilila nawa nokohala pomeja, kaanzi kombinga yomeho.
seatedToss.previewLabel: Omaupyakadi ogo: omondjolo gwa tilila dinima ditatu dya pewa maina Pedu, Pakati nOkule, kombinga yoshitwa, nolwaantu lwomanga lwomuntu ngoka nomundjolo gwomaupyakadi goshihuli shimwe nashimwe.
seatedToss.sheetHow: Tula omanga pefo pomeja pakati penu. Ngele oshimbwa tashi kwata mondjolo, ukameni omutaneko mouzapo weyi, pamuvo gwomondjolo ngoo.

decorateACard.guidance: Sanga omwaalo, nopo tanga oshimwe nomukwao okuhunga ondjalo ngele mwa hala, neakaayi nenge oompeni. Hakuna ondjalo yontoola.

Mu nyole ehumbo pamwe, nangwe omunhu gumwe a nyole ezi omunyoko a popia.
Omunhu oshoshe ota kwatela okuyimana nokufuma. Kapu na ekarata lyo ngoyo ngiwa.

conversationCards.guidance: Ulika kaadhi nolilongo. Kaashi na ondadalo ya nawa.
conversationCards.passNote: Omuntu nomuntu ota hala okuihe ndjoo.
conversationCards.groupSit: Ongeni mokwiimbelo, ondjila ya tala ofano. Muntu ngoo ota gwanena kaadi, nenge ondjiga inene, ota lombwela ondjokonona kumana.
conversationCards.groupPass: Ota tambula kaadi nokuyi komuntu ngoo. Muntu yoshe ota lombwela ehalo nenge oshilongo mo pa ofano, nokuyi nokuya.
conversationCards.groupNoSpeech: Okuyi kaadi kwa kala kwa tuvilwa. Muntu ota hala okuihe ndjoo ihe ya lombwela, nomuntu ihe ta hala okuluvalila.
conversationCards.groupEnd: Omutengo ogu ohagu gwedhwa kadhi yapitila kokati kehangano, nou ngele ehangano ohali kala lyu lihe. Kaku na omunhu ta gwana. Ehangano ohali hala okulihwa, otali nga oku lihwa nale.

photoPairs.guidance: Nyanyukwa efano, nopomwe nyanyukwa lyoshi li kwatha.
photoPairs.intro: **Hongeni omafano 2 kutya 6** koshipalanga shoyi. Ga ulikwa mokaxe kahe kapo, ihaa gu ndanda nokufuputha.

skipped.one: Ondjalo {count} ihai li efano lyoshi tu ngaa tu ulike.
skipped.other: Oondjalo {count} ihai ga li omafano getu tu ngaa tu ulike.

photoPairs.empty: Omafano goye ta ulike, pamwe mbuka oshishe.

pictureBingo.guidance: Shiinda omakaadhi ngoo. Opo ulikeni oshilongo shoshe moshiputu shonene komumwe.
pictureBingo.start: Nyanyukwa "Efano lyoshiyali" okuya ulika efano lyotango.
pictureBingo.ready: Otashi di ngoo ngele wa pula

calmBreathing.guidance: Fudhila mo sho onguluvi tayi koko, e to fudhila pondje sho tayi shonopala. Otayi mwena yoyene konima yomafudho gahamano.
calmBreathing.started: Osha tameke. Fudhila mo sho onguluvi tayi koko.
calmBreathing.finished: Oga li omafudho gahamano gomwiyo. Tameka ishewe uuna wa hala.

storyChain.guidance: Tegameni: omuvelavo 1 omunhu nomunhu, nou ongeleka efano lilandula.
storyChain.passNote: Lombwela omuvelavo gwoye nawa. Kakwa na okunyola, kakwa na okukala po. Omunhu ota nga okuyaleka.
storyChain.fullAdd: Omukanda gwa gwedhwa. Tameka omukanda gupya
storyChain.full: Omukanda ugwa na omafano 8. Lombwela omupango gwoyene, nou tameka omukanda gupya.
